documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the INR 1,000 Crore revenue milestone with significant improvements in EBITDA, PAT, and returns on capital employed. Management highlighted the successful commissioning of the new Alu-Zinc coating line (1,10,200 TPA) and the augmentation of existing colour-coating capacity, which together drove volume growth and enhanced operating leverage. The company maintained a debt-light balance sheet with zero long-term debt, funding capacity expansions through internal accruals and working capital credit. Looking ahead, management targets consolidated revenues of INR 1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27, backed by ongoing capacity additions and a planned investment in a new 6-Hi Reversible Cold-Rolling mill. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the fiscal year 2024-25, highlighting revenue of H584.18 Crore and a 15% increase in sales tonnage to 69,641 MT.

guidance.claim: The company expects the new integrated Alu-Zinc production line to result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The second expansion programme for the colour coating line is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing H125 Crore in two successive expansion programmes.
capex_expansion.quote: At Manaksia Steels, we are investing H125 Crore in two successive expansion programmes.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line to enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Alu-Zinc coated steel line was inaugurated in the Haldia factory.
capex_expansion.quote: Inauguration of new Aluzinc-Coated Steel Line in Haldia Factory.

orders_capacity.claim: Cold-rolled steel sheets and coils contributed 16.06% to the company's manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: Widely used in industries like automobiles, home appliances, hot-dipped galvanized steel and pre-painted steel products, they contributed 16.06% to the Company’s manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.

orders_capacity.claim: Hot-dipped galvanized steel contributed 39.75% to the company's manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company specialises in manufacturing hot-dipped galvanized steel for the building materials, white goods and electronic appliance industries, contributing 39.75% to the Company’s manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.

orders_capacity.claim: The pre-painted profile sheets segment contributed 41.88% to the company's manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: This segment contributed 41.88% to the Company’s manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that a decline in sales growth on both standalone and consolidated levels failed to offset challenges from global market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, decline in sales growth in standalone as well as consolidated levels, has failed to offset the challenges posed by the global market conditions.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year, generating revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
